title: Cross-Surface Authority — Worst Offenders & P0 Blockers
ranking_philosophy: Ranked by severity × blast_radius × exploitability × protocol_expansion_risk. Focus on what blocks MCP/ACP/A2A/SSH/hosted readiness, what can leak raw content, and what can mutate without receipts.

top_20_worst_offenders.label: GovernanceRuntime always EXECUTE
top_20_worst_offenders.reason: Every permission check in AgentLoop → ToolExecutor → CouncilGate is bypassed. The entire governance spine is a no-op at the agent loop level.

top_20_worst_offenders.label: MCP server bypasses all governance
top_20_worst_offenders.reason: MCP server is a completely independent dispatch universe. 13 of 17 tools are stubs. Zero governance integration. A hostile MCP client has unrestricted tool access.

top_20_worst_offenders.label: MCP mutation gate is string check
top_20_worst_offenders.reason: Tier-4/5 protection is advisory string presence. Any caller sets authorization_receipt to any value and passes. Cryptographic enforcement is absent.

top_20_worst_offenders.label: MCP zero authentication/authorization
top_20_worst_offenders.reason: MCPPerUserAuthorization model exists but is dead code. No per-user auth, no session scoping, no scope enforcement, no expiry check at MCP boundary.

top_20_worst_offenders.label: A2A server operates without governance
top_20_worst_offenders.reason: A2A accepts tasks/send with zero governance checks. Any internal agent can submit arbitrary tasks. Trust tiers defined but not enforced.

top_20_worst_offenders.label: GitHub approval is boolean, not verified
top_20_worst_offenders.reason: GitHub mutation adapter accepts approval_ok boolean. No HMAC verification, no signed approval receipt, no chain validation. Live PR mutation depends on caller honesty.

top_20_worst_offenders.label: MCP 13 stub tools, no descriptor verification
top_20_worst_offenders.reason: 13 of 17 MCP tools return dummy data. Tool descriptor provenance hash is computed but never verified at dispatch. Tool shadowing/poisoning has zero defense.

top_20_worst_offenders.label: MCP no content-light scanning
top_20_worst_offenders.reason: Server advertises content_light: True but never scans responses. A tool that accidentally leaks raw content through MCP has no safety net.

top_20_worst_offenders.label: MCP no evidence envelopes
top_20_worst_offenders.reason: All MCP tool responses are ad-hoc dicts. No evidence trail. Cannot prove what happened through MCP surface. Cross-surface correlation impossible.

top_20_worst_offenders.label: IDE sidecar disconnected governance
top_20_worst_offenders.reason: IDE sidecar uses static manifest lookup for permissions. Can grant capabilities even when cockpit is locked. Independent governance spine.

top_20_worst_offenders.label: GovernanceEngine decisions not emitted
top_20_worst_offenders.reason: Policy decisions exist only in-memory. No audit trail. Cannot audit what governance blocked/allowed. GateDecision has no decision_id.

top_20_worst_offenders.label: A2A no cryptographic attestation
top_20_worst_offenders.reason: A2A models have no HMAC/signature fields. If A2A goes operational, agents can forge task submissions and delegation receipts.

top_20_worst_offenders.label: Intent audit bypasses ReceiptStore
top_20_worst_offenders.reason: Desktop intent events go to a parallel non-canonical JSONL. Disconnected from evidence spine. Audit tools miss desktop intent data.

top_20_worst_offenders.label: ACP no evidence envelopes
top_20_worst_offenders.reason: ACP produces telemetry but no structured evidence. Edit proposals and permission requests lack receipt-backed audit trail.

top_20_worst_offenders.label: GitHub no canonical trust spine
top_20_worst_offenders.reason: GitHub mutation adapter has ad-hoc boolean gates. No trust spine model. No cryptographic attestation chain. Trust is boolean, not tiered.

top_20_worst_offenders.label: ConversationRuntime no surface awareness
top_20_worst_offenders.reason: Cannot enforce authority tier per-surface if the runtime doesn't know which surface initiated the turn. Cross-surface composition risk.

top_20_worst_offenders.label: BridgeMessage no authority fields
top_20_worst_offenders.reason: Every bridge message (intent requests, projection responses, lifecycle events) lacks authority provenance. Frontend cannot know what tier a message came from.

top_20_worst_offenders.label: ReceiptEnvelope missing cross-surface fields
top_20_worst_offenders.reason: ReceiptEnvelope missing authority_tier, trace_id, session_id at top level. Cannot correlate receipts with transport sessions or governance decisions.

top_20_worst_offenders.label: Tenant admin without approval
top_20_worst_offenders.reason: Enterprise tenant registration and permission grants have zero governance. Any operator can mutate multi-tenant isolation boundaries.

top_20_worst_offenders.label: MCP no workspace root enforcement
top_20_worst_offenders.reason: MCP tools use Path.cwd() with no boundary enforcement. Client can read git state from any directory the server can access. Path traversal has no guard.

top_5_p0_blockers.label: GovernanceRuntime always EXECUTE
top_5_p0_blockers.description: Every permission check in AgentLoop is a no-op. Must be fixed before any surface can claim governed operation. Fix: GovernanceRuntime.should_execute_tool must check NEVER/ASK/ALWAYS, trigger approval callback for ASK, and consult session-specific tool permissions.

top_5_p0_blockers.label: MCP server completely ungoverned
top_5_p0_blockers.description: MCP is a side-door bypassing all governance. Must be either wired into governance pipeline or hard-disabled until governance integration exists. Fix: Wire MCP through governance pipeline, enforce cryptographic mutation receipts, add content-light scanning, emit evidence envelopes, enforce per-user auth, verify descriptor integrity at dispatch.

top_5_p0_blockers.label: GitHub mutation without verified approval
top_5_p0_blockers.description: GitHub PR mutation depends on boolean approval_ok. No cryptographic verification. Trust spine is ad-hoc. Fix: Replace boolean with HMAC-signed approval receipt verification, implement GitHub Trust Spine with tiered trust and cryptographic attestation, wire build_github_operation_receipt into mutation adapter.

top_5_p0_blockers.label: Governance decisions not auditable
top_5_p0_blockers.description: Policy decisions are in-memory ghost state. No decision_id, no evidence envelope, no audit trail. Fix: Add decision_id to GateDecision, emit policy decision as evidence envelope to receipt store.

top_5_p0_blockers.label: ReceiptEnvelope not aligned with cross-surface spine
top_5_p0_blockers.description: ReceiptEnvelope missing authority_tier, trace_id, session_id at top level. Cannot correlate receipts across surfaces. Fix: Add authority_tier, trace_id, session_id, receipt_sha256 to ReceiptEnvelope.

quick_wins.label: Add tools/call to MCP sync handler

intentionally_deferred.label: A2A governance enforcement
intentionally_deferred.reason: A2A is partial/early. Full governance integration deferred to P4 after MCP and ACP are hardened.

intentionally_deferred.label: Tenant admin governance
intentionally_deferred.reason: Enterprise tenant operations by definition require admin authority. Full gating deferred to P3 (hosted/team mode).

intentionally_deferred.label: Fleet admin governance
intentionally_deferred.reason: Fleet orchestration is early. Full gating deferred to P3.
